title: Norse Genesis Visual Continuity Bible
principles: Source-bound facts and MythCanvas design locks are recorded separately.
A recurring character or landmark must reuse the same face, age, silhouette, palette, materials, and signature geometry unless the story explicitly changes it.
Narrative cards may change camera, action, weather, and lighting, but may not redesign a recurring entity.
Every generation prompt must name the relevant canonical card image as an identity or landmark reference; related-card IDs alone are not sufficient.
M01 uses matte painterly mythic realism, broad readable shapes, restrained detail, and one dominant visual thesis rather than glossy game-CG spectacle.

supports: Auðumbla licks salty rime and reveals Búri over three days.
Búri is fair in appearance, great, and mighty.
Yggdrasil is a tall ash that stands evergreen over Urðr's well.
The three Norns come from the water beneath the tree and shape fate.
Three roots extend in three directions beneath Yggdrasil.
Root-destination wording varies across witnesses and translations.

keep: restrained blue-white frost and ember light
subject detail clearly stronger than background detail

sourceBoundFacts: It has three great roots extending in three directions.
Urðr's well and the Norns are associated with the tree.
designLocks: One colossal twisted central trunk remains unified through the lower two thirds and divides only in the upper third into three principal crown leaders.
A broad asymmetrical umbrella crown uses small deep desaturated evergreen ash leaflets; foliage never becomes white leaves or blossoms.
Pale dew, frost, or snow may edge the foliage but may not recolor the crown.
Three massive buttress roots diverge visibly from the same trunk system.
Bark is charcoal brown with long vertical silver fissures and restrained moss only on water-facing surfaces.
No luminous blue veins, floating cities, realm bubbles, or labeled nine-world diagram.
Colossal pre-world humanoid with dark frost-stone skin, massive brow and nose, deep-set pale eyes, and long frost-white hair and beard.
Ancient and elemental rather than a normal Viking warrior; no armor, helmet, weapons, or tailored costume.
Maintain the same facial bone structure, hairline, beard shape, and relative scale in every appearance.

sourceBoundFacts: Primeval cow whose milk feeds Ymir.
She reveals Búri by licking salty rime.
designLocks: Colossal shaggy pale primeval cow, visibly larger and more ancient than ordinary cattle.
Use the same wide sweeping horn silhouette, heavy forehead, dark nose, long winter coat, and monumental shoulder mass.
Never substitute a smooth modern dairy cow or reduce her to ordinary livestock scale.
Four milk streams must read as four clean mythic rivulets without anatomical grotesqueness.

sourceBoundFacts: Revealed from salty rime over three days by Auðumbla's licking.
Described as fair in appearance, great, and mighty.
designLocks: Handsome, powerful early-god adult in his apparent thirties, not an elderly patriarch.
Pale wheat-blond shoulder-length hair, short neat beard, strong straight nose, clear gray-blue eyes, broad shoulders, and natural warm human skin.
Simple frost-wet pale drapery only; no crown, armor, runes, weapon, or giant traits.
Card 1003010003 is the face, age, hair, beard, and body-proportion reference.
Mature dual-eyed creator with dark brown braided hair and beard, charcoal fur cloak, and calm commanding posture.
No missing eye, ravens, Gungnir-like spear, throne, Valhalla imagery, or rune-mastery attributes in this early timeline.
Youthful athletic adult with wheat-blond shoulder-length hair, clean face or minimal stubble, light slate wrap, and active forward motion.
Compact steady adult with dark hair tied back in a short topknot, restrained beard or clean jaw, dark gray cloak, and grounded ritual posture.
Youthful dark wavy-haired man with a clean jaw or very light stubble and simple undyed natural wrap.
Always human after awakening; never a bark-skinned tree person.
Youthful brunette woman with the same oval face, dark brows, loose textured hair, and simple undyed natural wrap as card 1003010008.
Always human after awakening; never red-haired or a bark-skinned tree person.
Young adult with pale-blond braided hair, dark green and weathered ivory garments, calm retrospective bearing; not an elderly crone.
Young adult with warm light-brown wavy hair, pale gray-green garments, fluid present-tense gesture, and open attentive expression.
Young adult with dark hair, charcoal garments, alert forward-looking expression, and the sharpest silhouette of the three Norns.
Golden-blond active charioteer with the same youthful face, ivory-gold garments, and restrained sun-disc browpiece as card 1003010012.
Never red-haired and never redesigned as a heavily armored fantasy queen.
Silver-haired youthful male with cool gray skin light, charcoal-blue garments, narrow moon ornament, and quiet inward posture.
Lean ash-gray wolf with long running silhouette and pale amber eyes, always assigned to the sun pursuit.
Heavier charcoal wolf with broad shoulders and cold blue-gray eyes, always assigned to the moon pursuit.
Long root-clinging dark serpent-dragon with reduced limbs or no visible wings, rough bark-like scales, and a gnawing jaw built for roots.
Never a winged fire-breathing game dragon.
